subject: Compute view format has proven Vulkan-to-Metal mismatch; offset clarification and cache ownership
body:
Additional cross-file source review:
A. air_bridge.rs2761/2780 now exports view.format.as_raw() (VULKAN VkFormat) as ComputeDescriptor.view_format. runtime_pipeline.inc348 copies it unchanged to D2_VIEW_FORMAT; nord2_metal_bridge.c346 assigns l.view_format; n2t_view_format_check interprets it as METAL PixelFormat. This is a concrete enum-domain mismatch even before compiler manifest agreement. E.g RGBA8_UNORM Vulkan37 != Metal70; BGRA8 Vulkan44 != Metal80. Use an explicit documented alias representation/converter (including sRGB/integer view choices), preserve both allocation Metalformat and selected nativeview identity. Never pass raw Vk numbers as Metal. Test actual Rust-produced descriptor through bridge for known equal-footprint aliases and reject incompatible class/bytes.
B. Clarification to previous offset finding: runtime_pipeline.inc345 AND359 currently both write desc.range_offset into D2_OFFSET and LEVEL_OFFSET. Thus the in-tree level0 caller presently gets its offset through LEVEL_OFFSET while bridge ignores D2_OFFSET. The contract is still inconsistent and a split-view/malformedwire loses the true base; do NOT fix bridge by adding both existing equal values (would double offset). Define D2_OFFSET=resolved BO base offset, LEVEL_OFFSET=relative level offset; update producer+consumer together, then test nonzero base/level exactly once. Full plane payload loss remains independently confirmed.
C. tegu_v2_variant returns cache-hit borrowed selected after unlocking (runtime_pipeline.inc245,282), then caller only retains at388: concurrent cache eviction can free it. Miss path retains into cache but retains original new-object ownership too, while caller adds another retain. Return one owned reference acquired under lock in both branches, transfer/release on all errors/jobs consistently. Also require_v2/package version check is only inside cache MISS: a TGP1 buffer variant hit can bypass a later v2 requirement. Include package mode in key or validate version on every hit. Add same function/threadgroups -> threads cache case plus concurrent eviction/early release.
Already corrected: runtime now calls explicit weak tegu_mali_compile_compute_v2 when required; sampler plan flags now0; Metal buffer slot>=8 misuse changed to nativebinding>=8. Other previous gates are independent and remain reviewable.
